description:
jmap-types defines impl From<String> for Id and impl From<String> for State (crate-jmap-types/src/id.rs:79-83 via impl_string_newtype! macro). Canonical mail-server uses the From<String> impl directly (e.g. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs:370: State::from(n.to_string()), :644: State::from(state_n.to_string())). Siblings instead append .as_str() and use From<&str>, forcing an extra borrow that then re-allocates inside the From<&str> impl (id.rs:84-88: s.to_owned()).

Concretely:

  crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs:322   Id::from(format!(...).as_str())
  crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs:384   State::from(n.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs:445   State::from(current_state.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:166        Id::from(format!(...).as_str())
  crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:236        State::from(n.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:298        State::from(current_state.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:322-327    State::from(<multiline>.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:367-372    State::from(<multiline>.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs:267    Id::from(format!(...).as_str())
  crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs:328    State::from(n.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs:389    State::from(current_state.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs:127    Id::from(format!(...).as_str())
  crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs:281    State::from(format!(...).as_str())
  crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs:306,369,422  same shape
  crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs:171     Id::from(format!(...).as_str())
  crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs:240     State::from(n.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs:301     State::from(current_state.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/memory.rs:270       Id::from(format!(...).as_str())
  crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/memory.rs:331       State::from(n.to_string().as_str())
  crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/memory.rs:392       State::from(current_state.to_string().as_str())

Roughly 22 sites across 6 sibling crates. Fix is mechanical: drop the .as_str() — the From<String> impl already exists. Cookie-cutter drift from the canonical mail-server pattern; workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' propagation rule applies.

Why P2 not P3: this is a directly visible idiom drift in a 5-day code-burst that the canonical got right and the siblings didn't, and the section-2 prompt rule says clippy-class findings are P2 deviation default.
